# Golden Seatbelt profiles

Generated by `internal/sandboxsbpl.Build` from the fixed request in
`profile_test.go` (`baseRequest`); `<case>.sb` is the profile text and
`<case>.params` the `sandbox-exec -D` parameters. They are NOT recorded from a
Mac: no profile here has run under Seatbelt yet (register MAC-1, MAC-37).
Regenerate after reviewing a generator change:

    go test ./internal/sandboxsbpl -run TestGoldenProfiles -update
